label: TP
reason: Alert-TP driven by insufficient XSS sanitization. User input from request.getParameterValues() flows through doSomething() where only the last character is replaced with 'Z'. The resolved sink value (obj containing bar) still contains attacker-controlled HTML/script content in all positions except the final character. Example: '<script>test</script>' becomes '<script>tesZ</script>' - remaining script tags and event handlers stay intact, allowing XSS exploitation.

evidence.note: User input from getParameterValues() flows to response.getWriter().printf() via obj array containing bar. Sanitization in doSomething() only replaces last character with 'Z', leaving dangerous HTML/script content in sink expression unresolved.
